prompt: Generate 25 distinct tasks in small volunteer-run festivals. Batch 15/20.

tasks.topic: Community cinema festival scheduling finalized with three venues confirmed and projectionist roster assigned for weekend screenings
Volunteer training modules drafted and reviewed for front-of-house, ticketing, and usher roles at the neighborhood arts fair
Pop-up stage lighting rig tested and labeled; cabling maps created for the folk music courtyard stage
Local food vendor coordination ongoing with permits submitted and health inspector walkthrough scheduled for Friday
Handmade signage painted for children’s craft zone and wayfinding arrows sealed for weather resistance
Recycled-materials art exhibition layout measured and pedestal placements taped on community hall floor
Accessibility plan drafting underway, including quiet room setup and chair loans arranged with nearby church
Open-mic performer call finalized; time slots emailed and backup list prepared for late arrivals
Rain contingency plan in development with tent rentals shortlisted and cost comparisons documented
Neighborhood parade route chalked and steward positions assigned, with whistle and vest kits assembled
Acoustic busking permits being gathered from the town council with map of approved corners pending
Volunteer check-in desk assembled; badge printer tested and lanyards sorted by day and role color
Sustainability station signage drafted and compost bin pickups coordinated with local hauler
Heritage dance showcase rehearsal schedule confirmed and community center keys secured for evening slots
Festival app schedule content entry ongoing with stage times, workshop descriptions, and venue addresses
Portable PA system batteries charged and spare mic cables bundled for the storytelling gazebo
First aid corner setup plans drafted; volunteer nurse shifts partially filled and supply checklist started
Blanket seating area roped and staked; ground protection mats placed by the willow grove
Local artisan market booth maps under revision after fire lane adjustments from the city review
Community mural primer applied and chalk grid marked; paint palettes mixed for Saturday session
Kite-making workshop materials procurement underway, with dowels and tissue paper orders awaiting pickup
Bicycle valet corral fencing acquired and rack layout marked; signage arrows printed for main gate
Storytime tent sound bleed tests ongoing with soft partitions trialed between adjacent stages
Volunteer snack station stocked with shelf-stable items and hydration coolers labeled per shift
Neighborhood cleanup crew rosters forming; litter grabber delivery pending and route maps drafted
